description.value:
A pipe carved from a single dragon fang, the stem coiled into a serpentine dragon shape. Smoke drawn through it carries the breath of the original beast, and a measure of its constitution.

Attunement. Requires attunement.

Iron Lungs of the Wyrm. While attuned, a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus, you may automatically succeed on a saving throw against addiction to an inhaled substance burned in this pipe's bowl. It regains its uses daily.

effects.name: Dubious Pipe: Save Modifier
effects.description: Grants automatic success on saving throws against addiction to inhaled substances burned in the Dubious Pipe. It regains its uses daily, tracked on the pipe's native uses pool.
